nodes.name: Run Email Conversation Agent
nodes.notes: Runs one poll cycle: fetch unread in d2mconcierge, route by sender. Commander -> auto-reply in-thread; client -> WF-17 draft only. If n8n is containerized and cannot reach the host venv/filesystem, mount the repo into the container OR switch to the Webhook trigger below and call the HTTP endpoint that fronts run_cycle().

nodes.name: Webhook — /webhook/email-conversation (alt trigger)
nodes.notes: Alternative to the schedule trigger. POST to /webhook/email-conversation to force a poll cycle on demand (e.g. from a Gmail push notification relay). Wire this into 'Run Email Conversation Agent' if you prefer event-driven over polling.
